text:
Maya Patel: dropping a PR that consolidates the rate/quota guide sections and swaps the old SDK snippets for v2. includes a new section on 'how tiers are attributed' and a dashboard panel example. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/859
Diego Ramos: nice. can we clarify the billing attribution when a request spans multiple tiers (eg. reserved + burst)? users get confused about which tier pays.
Maya Patel: plan is a short explainer + a tiny worked example with numbers. also will add a note about how prefix-caching can change effective token counts.
Taylor Reed: heads-up: the snippet in examples/metrics uses the header X-Metering in one place. v2 expects X-RW-Metering-Context and the fluent call `client.withQuota({tier:","})`.
Maya Patel: thanks — I'll replace the header and switch to .withQuota() chains.
Rina S.: on the dashboard side, the panel screenshot currently shows `metering.requests_tiered_sum` but the actual Grafana query in the snippet references `metering.requests_by_tier_sum`. mismatch will confuse readers.
Maya Patel: good catch, updating query + will re-export the panel PNG.
docs-bot: PR 859 updated by maya — fmt/lint passed, snippet-check failed (missing fixture).
Diego Ramos: can Sam (eng-runtime) add the offline snippet test? it just needs to instantiate the v2 client and assert header presence. no network.
Maya Patel: I'll ping Sam and add a TODO in the PR for the fixture if they can't push today.
Taylor Reed: also consider adding a tiny migration callout under "Dedicated" customers: older agents (<=v3.1) still inject X-Metering. Suggest wording: "Dedicated customers using agents older than v3.2 should continue to send X-Metering until their agent is upgraded."
Rina S.: +1. also update the changelog entry to mention that metric names were consolidated — support tickets will reference that.
Maya Patel: added migration callout and linked agent release notes. changed changelog draft.
Diego Ramos: nit: use inline code ticks for short flags and fenced blocks for the full snippet in the examples. our docs linter enforces that.
Maya Patel: cleaned formatting across the page.
docs-bot: new commit pushed by maya — fixed headers, aligned metric names, updated changelog. preview link: https://deploy-preview-859--docs.redwood.ai/usage/metering
Taylor Reed: preview looks good. the worked example numbers are helpful. can we add a one-line note about embeddings being metered per vector rather than token? a couple customers asked about that.
Maya Patel: added a parenthetical line explaining embedding units and linked the embeddings billing page.
Diego Ramos: still waiting on the snippet test. Sam, any ETA?
Rina S.: if test is delayed, can we land and follow up with a small patch? it's low risk and customer-facing improvements are helpful now.
Sam Ortiz: pushed a tiny fixture to the PR branch — uses a mocked client and asserts header name and .withQuota() presence. no network.
docs-bot: CI snippet-check passed after Sam's fixture.
Maya Patel: merging after Netlify preview finishes. thanks everyone for quick reviews. I'll message #support once prod docs deploys so they can update canned responses. :wave:
Taylor Reed: awesome, thanks — and maybe a short internal note to #eng-runtime about the metric name rename so dashboards don't break silently.
Maya Patel: will do. follow-up action: add a quick runbook entry for support to map old metric names to new ones.
